# Original extension interoperability fixtures

These are original PixelWall test inputs and independently captured Aseprite outputs, not copied third-party artwork or implementation code.

- `png-palette-oracle.json`: 50 original RGBA colors generated with LCG seed 72 (1664525, 1013904223, 32-bit wrap, byte bits 16–23), written to a 50×1 RGBA PNG. The `output` list was captured from Aseprite 1.3.18.5 `Palette{fromFile=...}` and `getColor`. This pins transparent insertion, color deduplication and RGBA octree ordering.
- `indexed-palette.png`: Generated by an original Lua script creating a 2×1 indexed sprite with four palette entries: red, blue, green, gray; pixels reference entries 1 and 2. Aseprite's saved PNG retains all four entries and gives entry 0 alpha 0. The expected palette list was separately queried with `Palette{fromFile=...}`.

Oracle executable: `/tmp/pixelwall-aseprite-oracle/build/bin/Aseprite.app/Contents/MacOS/aseprite`, official 1.3.18.5 source self-build (runtime 1.3.18.5-dev, API 41). No compiled Aseprite software is included. The Lua API is documented at https://www.aseprite.org/api/palette .
